title: Bearish break (level 2)
description: Asserted at level 2. The snippet's high comes late (65,288 on 1 Aug 23:00), so the whole decline lies inside level 0's first leg, and at level 1 it is a single dip. One level down that decline is a downleg with its own swings: the 63,692 low, a bounce to 64,856, then the close of 62,863 at 15:00 breaks below it. A one-candle break at 01:00 (64,165) is at the same level, and the recovery has a bullish break at 19:00 (63,346).
